title: Polynomial-time concatenation of iterated outputs
statement:
Let $g,e:
\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable. Suppose $a',k',b,l\in\mathbb{N}$ and that, for every bit string $w$ and every $i\in\mathbb{N}$, the $i$-fold iterate of $g$ satisfies $|(g^{i}(w))|\le b(|w|+1)^l$. Then the function sending $w$ to the concatenation of $e(g^{i}(w))$ over all integers $i$ from $0$ through $a'(|w|+1)^{k'}$ is polynomial-time computable.
